info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Replace Loyalty Loyalty Transfer-v2-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Transfer Management API allows businesses to efficiently manage the transfer of loyalty points between accounts. This operation is essential for maintaining customer satisfaction by enabling point sharing, promotions, or redeeming rewards seamlessly. Typical consumers of this API include loyalty program administrators and customer service teams who facilitate transfers on behalf of customers. The endpoint supports secure and efficient updates to loyalty point balances, ensuring accurate tracking of customer engagement.

put.summary: Transfer loyalty points to another account.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to transfer your loyalty points to another user's account. Ensure that you have sufficient points available for transfer and provide the recipient's account details.

requestBody.description: The request body for transferring loyalty points. This should contain the necessary information including the recipient's details and the amount of points to be transferred.
